title: Local marketplace sandbox build
context: Built a repo-local marketplace sandbox without registering it in Codex.
evidence: Marketplace sandbox generated docs/nwn-skill-pack/.codex-tmp/marketplace-candidate/marketplace.json with one local plugin entry.
Sandbox marketplace uses source.path ./plugins/nwn-server-gamedev-pack and policy AVAILABLE/ON_INSTALL.
Sandbox plugin passed plugin-creator validate_plugin.py after setting PYTHONPATH to the local PyYAML dependency folder.
Sandbox packaged skill passed skill-creator quick_validate.py.
missing_evidence: This record does not prove codex plugin marketplace add, Codex UI discovery, new-thread trigger behavior, or NWN runtime correctness.
notes: Static marketplace-shape evidence only; INSTALL-001 is still required for actual install smoke.
